pages.text: Like Create's striated ores, TFMG places large layered clusters in the Overworld, between $(item)Y -30 and Y 70$(), in about one chunk out of 18. Each cluster follows one of four patterns, with stone or deepslate between the bands: $(li)$(item)Bauxite$() with smooth basalt, granite and andesite.

Bauxite is the ore of aluminium. $(li)$(item)Galena$() with smooth basalt, dripstone and deepslate. Galena is a lead-bearing stone. $(li)$(item)Lignite$() with tuff, deepslate and scoria. Lignite is a soft brown coal. $(li)$(item)Fireclay$() with sand, gravel and crimsite.

Bauxite and galena are full building stones: put them in a stonecutter for cut, polished and brick variants. Lignite and sulfur blocks drop themselves when mined. A cluster is big, so when you see one band in a cave wall, dig along it.$(br2)Look for these layers in caves and ravines: they are much easier to spot than single ore blocks.
